what_differs: WAGR-44 (Open, Phase 1, last updated Sep 14) plans in-Salesforce Commission Cost and TAC fields and is blocked on formulas. On Sep 1 the client defined TAC as deposit plus commission for P&L reporting, and on Sep 25 the team decided that BA commission calculation stays outside Salesforce at launch, so the commission part of TAC has no Salesforce source yet.
suggested_action: Suggest re-grooming WAGR-44: record the Sep 1 TAC definition, decide whether TAC is computed in Salesforce (with commission data coming back from Jay's tool) or in the BI layer, and link WAGR-467/WAGR-468. Also remove the 'redeposit workflow out of Phase 1' line if redeposits are now in scope (see WAGR-464).
